concepts.title: Bézout identity for polynomials over a field
concepts.description: The monic greatest common divisor of polynomials a,b, not both zero, is ua+vb for some polynomials u,v. In particular coprime polynomials admit ua+vb=1.

concepts.title: Bi-Lipschitz map
concepts.description: A bijection between metric spaces for which both the map and its inverse are Lipschitz.

concepts.title: Block sequence relative to a Schauder basis
concepts.description: A sequence of nonzero finitely supported vectors xₙ such that max supp(xₙ)<min supp(xₙ₊₁); its closed linear span is a block subspace.

concepts.title: Completeness of Bochner Lᵖ spaces
concepts.description: If X is a Banach space and1≤p≤∞, the Bochner space Lᵖ(μ;X) is complete for its norm.

concepts.title: Borel σ-algebra of a topological space
concepts.description: The σ-algebra generated by the open subsets of the space.

concepts.title: Boundary of a subset of a topological space
concepts.description: The boundary of A is its closure with its interior removed.

concepts.title: Bounded linear functional
concepts.description: A linear map from a real or complex normed vector space to its scalar field satisfying |ℓ(x)|≤C∥x∥ for one finite C and every x.

concepts.title: Bounded linear operator
concepts.description: A linear map T:X→Y between normed vector spaces is bounded if ∥Tx∥≤C∥x∥ for one finite constant C and every x∈X.

concepts.title: Banach space c₀ of null sequences
concepts.description: The scalar sequences tending to zero, with the supremum norm.

concepts.title: C² embedded surface in ℝ³
concepts.description: A subset of ℝ³ that locally, after a rigid coordinate change, is the graph of a twice continuously differentiable real function of two variables.

concepts.title: Calderón reproducing formula for an inhomogeneous dyadic resolution
concepts.description: Let φ₀,ψ₀ be fixed Schwartz kernels and, for j≥1, let φ_j,ψ_j be the standard dyadic dilations of fixed Schwartz kernels with annular Fourier support, with φ̂₀ψ̂₀+∑_{j≥1}φ̂_jψ̂_j=1 and the high-frequency terms supported in dyadic annuli. Then f=ψ₀*φ₀*f+∑_{j≥1}ψ_j*φ_j*f in S′ for every tempered distribution f.

concepts.title: Carathéodory’s approximation theorem by finite Blaschke products
concepts.description: Every holomorphic f:𝔻→ℂ with |f|≤1 is a locally uniform limit of finite Blaschke products. If f(0)=0, the approximating products can also be chosen to vanish at zero.

concepts.title: Cauchy’s projection formula for convex bodies
concepts.description: For a convex body K and unit u, the volume of K projected onto u⊥ equals ½∫|u·v| dS_K(v).

concepts.title: Cauchy–Schwarz inequality for semi-inner-product C*-modules
concepts.description: For x,y in a semi-inner-product C*-module, |⟨x,y⟩|²≤∥⟨x,x⟩∥⟨y,y⟩ in the order on the coefficient C*-algebra.

concepts.title: Chain rule for Fréchet derivatives
concepts.description: If g is Fréchet differentiable at x and f at g(x), then f∘g is Fréchet differentiable at x with D(f∘g)(x)=Df(g(x))∘Dg(x).

concepts.title: C^k map between Euclidean open sets
concepts.description: For a finite integer k≥0, a map is C^k if all component partial derivatives of order at most k exist and are continuous. C^0 means continuous.

concepts.title: Closed range of a bounded linear operator
concepts.description: A bounded linear operator has closed range when its image is a closed subset of its codomain.

concepts.title: Closure of a subset of a topological space
concepts.description: The closure of A is the intersection of all closed subsets containing A; a set is closed when its complement is open.
